recipes.title: Crispy Cheese & Herb Potato Wedges
recipes.description: Golden, crunchy potato wedges tossed with melted cheese, garlic, and fresh rosemary.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Cut 500g potatoes into thick wedges and pat dry with paper towels.
Toss wedges with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt, and 0.5 tsp black pepper.
Spread on baking tray and roast at 200°C for 18 minutes until golden.
Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with 80g grated cheddar, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 1 tbsp fresh rosemary.
Return to oven for 2 minutes until cheese melts.
Serve hot and enjoy.

recipes.title: Japanese Edamame with Sea Salt
recipes.description: Steamed soybeans finished with flaky sea salt and sesame—simple, protein-packed.
instructions: Bring 1 litre water to boil in a large pot over high heat.
Add 300g frozen edamame and 2 tsp salt, stir once.
Simmer over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until tender.
Drain in a colander and transfer to a serving bowl.
Sprinkle with 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds and extra salt to taste.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Spanish Tortilla (Potato Omelette)
recipes.description: Silky potato and onion frittata, flipped and finished—rustic Spanish comfort.
instructions: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a 25cm non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat.
Add 400g thinly sliced potatoes and 1 medium thinly sliced onion, season with 1 tsp salt and 0.5 tsp black pepper.
Cook gently over medium-low heat for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are soft.
While potatoes cook, whisk 6 large eggs in a bowl until combined.
Pour cooked potatoes into whisked eggs and mix gently to combine.
Heat remaining 2 tbsp olive oil in the same frying pan over medium heat.
Pour egg and potato mixture into pan, stir briefly, then let cook undisturbed over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Slide onto a plate, invert back into pan to cook the other side over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Slide onto a serving plate and let rest for 2 minutes before cutting into wedges.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Crispy Chickpea & Herb Roast
recipes.description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas seasoned with za'atar, lemon, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Pat the drained chickpeas thoroughly dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Toss the chickpeas with 1.5 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp za'atar, 0.5 tsp garlic powder, 0.5 tsp sea salt, and 0.25 tsp black pepper until evenly coated.
Spread chickpeas in a single layer on the prepared tray and roast at 200°C for 20–22 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Remove from oven and toss with 1 tsp lemon zest and 1 tbsp fresh parsley while still warm.
Cool for 2–3 minutes on the tray, then transfer to a serving bowl or container.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Cucumber & Tofu Summer Roll
recipes.description: Fresh rice-paper rolls with silken tofu, cucumber, herbs, and spicy peanut dip.

ingredients_detailed.name: firm tofu
ingredients_detailed.quantity: 200g, pressed and cut into thin strips

instructions: Wrap the firm tofu block in clean kitchen towel, place on a plate, and weigh down with a heavy object for 10 minutes to press out excess moisture.
While tofu presses, julienne 1 medium cucumber (200g) into thin matchsticks and set aside.
Whisk together 3 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp sriracha, 4 tbsp water, and 1 tbsp soy sauce until smooth; set dipping sauce aside.
Remove tofu from towel, cut pressed block into thin 0.5cm strips, and set on a clean plate.
Fill a wide shallow bowl with room-temperature water and submerge 1 rice paper sheet for 5–7 seconds until pliable but still slightly firm.
Lay softened rice paper flat on a clean damp surface and arrange a line of tofu strips, cucumber matchsticks, 3–4 mint leaves, and 3–4 cilantro leaves across the lower third.
Fold the bottom edge of the rice paper over the filling, then fold in the left and right sides, and roll tightly away from you until sealed.
Repeat steps 5–7 with remaining 3 rice paper sheets to make 4 rolls total.
Serve the 4 summer rolls with the peanut-sriracha dipping sauce and lime wedges for squeezing.

recipes.title: Charred Broccolini with Dukkah & Tahini
recipes.description: Smoky roasted broccolini coated with Egyptian spice blend and creamy tahini drizzle.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Toss 300g trimmed broccolini with 2 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 tsp sea salt, and 0.25 tsp black pepper, ensuring even coating.
Spread broccolini in a single layer on the prepared tray and roast at 220°C for 10–12 minutes, stirring once halfway through.
While broccolini roasts, whisk together 3 tbsp tahini, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 minced garlic clove, and 2–3 tbsp water until pourable.
Transfer roasted broccolini to a serving plate and immediately sprinkle with 2 tbsp dukkah spice blend.
Drizzle the tahini-lemon sauce over the top and serve immediately while hot.

recipes.description: Crispy, spiced Middle Eastern chickpeas with herbaceous za'atar and lemon zest.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Toss 400g drained chickpeas with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1.5 tbsp za'atar, 1 tsp lemon zest, and 1/4 tsp sea salt until evenly coated.
Spread chickpeas in single layer on prepared tray and roast at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through.
Cool on tray for 2 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Bánh Mì Toasts
recipes.description: Toasted baguette with pickled vegetables, pâté, and cilantro in bold Southeast Asian style.

ingredients_detailed.name: baguette
ingredients_detailed.quantity: 1 small (200g), sliced into 4 pieces lengthwise and halved

instructions: Combine 60g julienned carrot, 40g julienned daikon, 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt in a bowl; set aside for 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 200°C and arrange baguette halves cut-side up on a baking tray.
Toast baguette at 200°C for 5–6 minutes until golden and crispy.
Spread 75g pâté evenly on each warm toasted baguette piece.
Spread 2 tbsp mayonnaise over pâté layer.
Top each toast with pickled carrot and daikon, 1 sliced jalapeño, and 15g fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Spanish Chorizo & Manchego Skewers
recipes.description: Pan-fried spiced chorizo and cheese cubes on small skewers with smoky paprika finish.
instructions: Thread 12 small wooden or metal skewers, alternating 150g chorizo pieces and 100g manchego cheese cubes (1 of each per skewer).
Heat 1.5 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat in a large skillet.
Fry skewers over medium-high heat for 4–5 minutes, turning occasionally, until chorizo is browned and cheese begins to soften.
Transfer skewers to plate and sprinkle with 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 thyme sprigs, and 1/4 tsp black pepper.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Crispy Cheese & Herb Crackers
recipes.description: Buttery, crunchy homemade crackers with sharp cheddar and fresh rosemary.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine 1 cup (125g) flour, 1/2 tsp sea salt, and 1/4 tsp black pepper in a bowl.
Rub in 50g cold cubed butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Stir in 75g grated cheddar and 1 tbsp chopped rosemary until combined.
Add 3–4 tbsp water gradually, mixing until dough just holds together.
Roll dough between parchment sheets to 3mm thickness and cut into 2cm squares.
Bake at 200°C for 10–12 minutes until golden and crisp.
Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire rack.

recipes.title: Spiced Chickpea Roast
recipes.description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas with cumin, paprika, and a pinch of cayenne heat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Drain and thoroughly pat dry one 400g tin of chickpeas with clean kitchen towels.
Toss dried chickpeas with 2 tbsp olive oil until evenly coated.
Mix 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, and 3/4 tsp sea salt in a small bowl.
Sprinkle spice mixture over oiled chickpeas and toss until all pieces are coated.
Spread in single layer on prepared tray and roast at 220°C for 15–18 minutes.
Cool on tray for 5 minutes; they will crisp further as they cool.

recipes.title: Banana & Peanut Butter Oat Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, chewy no-sugar-added cookies with mashed banana, peanut butter, and oats.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mash 2 medium ripe bananas in a large bowl until smooth.
Stir 100g natural peanut butter and 1 tsp vanilla extract into mashed banana until well blended.
Add 120g rolled oats, 60g flour, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1/4 tsp sea salt; fold until just combined.
Drop 12 spoonfuls of dough onto prepared sheet, spaced 3cm apart.
Bake at 180°C for 12–14 minutes until edges are set but centres still soft.
Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack to cool completely.
